title: Chris Mellon says disclosure 'green light' continued after Clinton's loss
summary: Grant Cameron tells of Chris Mellon says disclosure 'green light' continued after Clinton's loss, about 2016-2017 at United States (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And so I phoned up Chris the same day. I said, "Chris, so what's going on? Is it dead? Is it No." He said, "Green light still going. It's even bigger than before."

plain: A UFO researcher named Grant Cameron says that when Hillary Clinton lost the 2016 US presidential election, he worried that the push for disclosure, meaning the government publicly revealing what it knows about UFOs, was dead. He says he phoned Chris Mellon, a man involved in that push alongside the musician Tom DeLonge, the same day. According to Cameron, Mellon told him the "green light" was still on and the effort was "even bigger than before", which would mean the plan did not depend on who won.
